correctness.rationale: For rook graph K_m□K_n, m,n>=2, selected edge endpoints cannot have a third crossing edge. Within a connected chosen-edge component, row/column neighborhoods are cliques and force only isolated horizontal edge H, isolated vertical edge V, or perpendicular induced 2-edge elbow E. Distinct components must use disjoint occupied row and column labels. The row/column occupancies (h+2v+2e, 2h+v+2e), selected edges h+v+2e and orientation factors yield the exact falling-factorial polynomial and two-label EGF. Occupancy bounds prove maximum m except odd square m=n where maximum m-1, with all equality compositions and top coefficients. Independent third-edge enumeration for (m,n)=(2,2),(2,3),(3,3),(3,4) matched full coefficients, with packing totals 9,22,64,229, maxima 2,2,2,3 and counts of maxima 4,12,45,72. Bounded tests are corroboration; component bijection is universal proof.
residual_risks: Two complete-factor Cartesian products only, m,n>=2; original induced-star observation not novel.
Higher n proof combinatorial, finite enumerations not universal.
